title: Chronos resampling error
description:
This is probably a tune issue but will document here

``` r
library(tidymodels)
library(tabular)

chi_split <- initial_time_split(Chicago, prop = 1 - (14/nrow(Chicago)))
chi_split
#> <Training/Testing/Total>
#> <5684/14/5698>
chi_train <- training(chi_split)
chi_test  <- testing(chi_split)

chi_rs <-
  chi_train |>
  select(ridership, Austin:California, date) |> 
  sliding_period(
    index = "date",  
    period = "week",
    lookback = 52 * 15,
    assess_stop = 2,
    step = 2 
  )
```

``` r
# regression

chrn_spec <- tabular_chronos(mode = "regression")

reg_fit <- 
  chrn_spec |> 
  fit(ridership ~ ., data = chi_train)

predict(reg_fit, chi_test)
#> # A tibble: 1,024 × 1
#>    .pred
#>    <dbl>
#>  1  15.0
#>  2  20.8
#>  3  21.2
#>  4  20.6
#>  5  20.9
#>  6  21.2
#>  7  20.2
#>  8  14.8
#>  9  18.8
#> 10  21.1
#> # ℹ 1,014 more rows

chrn_reg_res <- 
  chrn_spec |> 
  fit_resamples(
    ridership ~ ., 
    resamples = chi_rs
  )
#> → A | error:   The required column "..y" is missing.
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x1
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x3
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x6
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x9
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x11
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x13
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x16
#> Warning: All models failed. Run `show_notes(.Last.tune.result)` for more
#> information.
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x16
#> 
```

``` r
# quantile regression

chrn_qntl_spec <- 
  tabular_chronos() |> 
  set_mode("quantile regression", quantile_levels = (1:9) / 10)

qntl_fit <- 
  chrn_qntl_spec |> 
  fit(ridership ~ ., data = chi_train)

predict(qntl_fit, chi_test)
#> # A tibble: 1,024 × 1
#>    .pred_quantile
#>         <qtls(9)>
#>  1           [15]
#>  2         [20.8]
#>  3         [21.2]

#>  5         [20.9]
#>  6         [21.2]
#>  7         [20.2]
#>  8         [14.8]
#>  9         [18.8]
#> 10         [21.1]
#> # ℹ 1,014 more rows

chrn_qntl_res <- 
  chrn_qntl_spec |> 
  fit_resamples(
    ridership ~ ., 
    resamples = chi_rs
  )
#> → A | error:   The required column "..y" is missing.
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x1
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x3
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x6
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x8
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x10
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x13
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x15
#> Warning: All models failed. Run `show_notes(.Last.tune.result)` for more
#> information.
#> There were issues with some computations   A: x16
#> 
```

<sup>Created on 2026-06-24 with [reprex v2.1.1](https://reprex.tidyverse.org)</sup>

In both cases, the notes were:

```
→ A | error:   The required column "..y" is missing.
There were issues with some computations   A: x7
```
